data.content:
FC Dallas hits the road for one final time in the regular season in 2026, as they take on Sporting Kansas City.

Both teams are coming off a disappointing result on Wednesday night, with Dallas looking to lock up a top-four playoff spot in the West, while Sporting is looking to wrap up one of the worst seasons in club history.

Let’s dive into some notes, predictions, and more.
